## Definition of Done

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --lib` pass.
- [ ] New Rust files carry an SPDX header.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or leftover debug logging in the diff.
- [ ] UI changes verified in both light and dark themes.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits.
